plain_text:
Bernard Lenrow appears in 82 recordings across 10 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1943 to 1957. The credits here include host, performer, and narrator.

In this archive, you will hear Bernard Lenrow most often in Molle Mystery Theatre, Casey, Crime Photographer, Words at War, The Shadow, X Minus One, Dimension X, Gang Busters, and Stroke of Fate.

Characters credited here include Geoffrey Barnes.
